text:
Situation: Hydrochlorothiazide has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-01-19, spanning 45 months as of 2026-10-21. Aurobindo Pharma USA's and Chartwell Molecular Holdings LLC's quinapril/hydrochlorothiazide tablets remain listed with discontinuation of manufacture cited. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. lists hydrochlorothiazide capsules as to be discontinued with a business decision to discontinue manufacture noted. Current inventory across three Corvale sites ranges from 19 to 27 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows hydrochlorothiazide shortage status current since 2023-01-19. Aurobindo Pharma USA and Chartwell Molecular Holdings LLC quinapril/hydrochlorothiazide tablets remain current with discontinuation of manufacture cited. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. hydrochlorothiazide capsules listed as to be discontinued with business decision to discontinue manufacture noted.

Our position: Inventory is critically low at all sites. Alternate manufacturers not on FDA's shortage list are available with acceptable inspection histories. Immediate procurement is required to maintain supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. (plant NAI 2024-07-26) — approved by pharmacy director.
2. Buyer to place orders with DirectRx (plant NAI 2026-06-04) — approved by pharmacy director.
3. Buyer to place orders with Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited (plant VAI 2023-10-20) — approved by pharmacy director.
4. Buyer to place orders with A-S Medication Solutions (plant VAI 2026-08-12) — approved by pharmacy director.
5. Buyer to evaluate ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (plant not identified) — approved by pharmacy director.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further shortage updates.
